text_simplified: Children acquire their dispositions, habits, and words from their parents. As Malik ibn Dinar (may Allah have mercy on him) pointed out to the man who complained about his wife's frequent cursing of the children: if a child grows up in a home where he hears remembrance of Allah, supplication, and wholesome words, he grows up upon that; and if he hears insults, cursing, and foul speech, he is affected by what he hears.
